title: Steamboat Willie
studio: Walt Disney Studio (dir. Walt Disney & Ub Iwerks); distributed by Celebrity Productions
contents: Iconic opening: the steamboat puffs along, Mickey whistles at the wheel (the shot Disney still uses as its logo), then Captain Pete storms in and kicks him off the bridge; ends with Pete chewing tobacco and the parrot.
pd_us: US: PD since 1 Jan 2024 (published 1928, 95-year term ended). Source: Wikipedia 'Steamboat Willie' > Copyright status; Duke Center for the Study of the Public Domain, 'Mickey, Disney, and the Public Domain' (Jennifer Jenkins).
pd_korea: Korea: PD. Korean Copyright Act Art. 42 protects cinematographic works for 70 years from publication (50 years before the 1 Jul 2013 amendment, which did not revive expired works); a film published in 1928 expired at the end of 1998 at the latest, so 1955-or-earlier films are PD. Korea's 1996 Berne restoration only covered foreign works still within the Korean term, so it does not apply.
trademark_caveat: Mickey Mouse is a live Disney trademark, and the Steamboat Willie wheel clip is Disney Animation's logo. Reusing the footage is fine; do NOT use Mickey in a channel name, logo, thumbnail branding, or anything implying Disney endorses or made the video. Later Mickey designs (red shorts, white gloves in colour, etc.) are still copyrighted: use only this 1928 footage.
audio: kept: original 1928 Cinephone soundtrack (whistling, 'Steamboat Bill', sound effects), AAC 160k mono
